items.title: Building effective agents
facts: Distinguishes model-directed agent decisions and tool use from predefined workflows.
Agents use observed tool results, stopping conditions and human checkpoints.
Recommends adding complexity only when outcomes justify it.
items.application: Give the app a small bounded tool loop that does research work, rather than just making the chat larger.
items.limit: The article flags its tooling landscape as dated; not used for current SDK/API implementation claims.

items.title: Linear for Agents
facts: Users can delegate an entire issue while human ownership remains.
items.application: Let the user delegate an outcome and inspect its changes without supervising each UI action.
items.limit: A design reference, not a paper research workflow or proof of this app.

items.title: Elicit’s Research Agent
facts: Natural language research with source scope controls and follow-up.
Research process and sources remain inspectable.
items.application: Research scope and evidence remain visible while the agent selects the next retrieval/read step.
